claims.content: A new customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.

scope_contract.goal_statement: A new customer wants to create a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer completes registration of a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer is a new, not-yet-registered user who initiates the Register Customer Account use case.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has a free membership account on JTVauctions.com.
in_scope_actions: Register as a new customer on JTVauctions.com
excluded_adjacent_actions: Checkout or payment for won items
Configuring or accessing preferred payment types after registration

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is a new, not-yet-registered user on JTVauctions.com.
The Customer is accessing the JTVauctions.com website.
The Customer has access to a valid email address and a valid phone number for account creation.

The use case is triggered when a new, not-yet-registered Customer decides to register on JTVauctions.com, clicks the 'Register Now' link in the top navigation bar, and begins entering required information on the registration page to create a FREE membership account.
The Customer enters their First Name and Last Name into the designated text fields.

The Customer provides an E-mail Address, entered twice and verified, and creates a unique Member 'Handle' (Member ID), which can be the email address and must be unique in the database customer table.
The Customer creates a Password of 8 to 12 characters and verifies it by re-entering it in the 'Verify Password' field.
The Customer selects a payment method (PayPal, Amazon Payments, or Credit Card) and provides corresponding billing details if Credit Card is chosen.
The Customer checks the box to accept and agree to the Terms of Use.
The Customer clicks the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button to complete the registration process immediately without providing additional optional information.

The system completes the registration process and triggers an automated 'transactional' Thank You email instructing the Customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.

Diverges from Step 6: Instead of clicking the 'I Want to Sign in Now!' button to complete the short registration, the Customer may choose to proceed to Registration Page 2, where they may optionally provide additional information such as billing/shipping addresses, shipping preferences, and email preferences; the Customer then clicks the 'Finish Now' button to complete the full registration process immediately by providing additional shipping and billing information.

At Step 2, if the E-mail Address is already present in the customer table, the system notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use and asks whether they need to reset the password for that account; if the user indicates 'yes', the system generates an email with a temporary password. Registration with that duplicate email cannot proceed.
At Step 2, if the Member ID (Handle) is already present in the database customer table, the registration cannot proceed with that duplicate handle.
At Step 3, if the Password is not 8 to 12 characters, the input is invalid and the registration cannot proceed.

At Step 5, if the Customer does not agree to be bound by the Terms of Use Agreement, they cannot access or use the Website or submit an order or bid on the Website; therefore registration cannot be completed.

At Step 6 (or at the Alternative Flow's 'Finish Now' submission), if the Customer attempts to submit before checking the Terms of Use checkbox, the 'I Want to Sign in Now!'/'Finish Now' button is grayed out to prevent submission; if clicked anyway, a popup message tells the Customer they must read and agree to the Terms of Use before they can proceed.

At Step 7, when the system completes registration, the Consumer Protection negative file is cross-referenced; if there is a match, the registrant receives the message: 'We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time. If you believe this message to be in error, please contact our Customer Service team at: 800-550-8393.' Account creation is therefore not completed.

At Step 5, if the Customer is under 13 years old, or is between 13 and 18 years old and using the Website without permission of a parent or guardian, they are not in an authorized user category and cannot use the Website; registration cannot proceed.

The registration process completes successfully and the Customer's free membership account is created with the provided registration data; if the Customer completes the full registration path (Registration Page 2), any optional billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences are saved to the account profile.

The system displays a 'Welcome Back!' message and presents the Sign In page with fields for Member ID/Email and Password after the registration process completes. In the short-registration path, after being taken to the sign-in page, the system returns the Customer to their previous product details page if they were browsing before registering, or to the home page if they were on the home page.
The system shows a registration confirmation or transitions the Customer to a logged-in state, making the 'My Account' link accessible in the navigation bar.
The system triggers an automated transactional 'Thank You' email instructing the Customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list.
The system displays a pop-up message instructing the Customer to add shop@jewelryTV.rsys1.com to their address book or safe senders list and to enable cookies in their browser.

That is inconsistent with the goal's 'free membership' success condition and with the in-scope action of simply creating a free membership account. (atomic grounding: candidate remains incomplete (Explicit evidence that payment method selection is optional during registration is not present; the cited cards support selection during registration and a separate post-registration setup page, but not that registration may be completed without selecting a payment method.))

[mainflow_postconditions_reachability] Main Flow only describes the short-registration path ending with the Customer clicking 'I Want to Sign in Now!' without providing optional information, and never includes the full Registration Page 2 path. Postcondition 1's conditional outcome ('if the Customer completes the full registration path... optional billing/shipping addresses and shipping preferences are saved') is therefore not reachable from the Main Flow.
